collection.description: A nonbinary dancer asks to perform without being assigned to either group of dancers.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A village celebration traditionally divides dancers into two groups. A nonbinary dancer asks to perform without being assigned either one.

text_only.reason: the ceremony's custom is described; nobody celebrates on this page

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The dancers experiment; it becomes a beautiful, optional part of the ceremony.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The dancer performs a solo interlude while others retain familiar steps.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: People organize by preferred movements rather than gender; rehearsals are chaotic but joyful.
